base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_012"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN rulings AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_090"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'uncommon'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT T4."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS T4
    INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T5 ON T4."XCL_072" = T5."XCL_082"
    WHERE T5."XCL_077" = 'German' AND T5."XCL_076" LIKE '%Gegenmittel%'
  )
GROUP BY T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_012"
ORDER BY MIN(T3."XCL_088") ASC
LIMIT 3
